scientific_limits: This audit can identify mechanical compression, discontinuities, coverage gaps, and lineage instability.
It cannot establish the true market price of QB scarcity.
It cannot infer that a specific named QB is too high or too low.
Production V2 Phase 1 is transparent but uncalibrated.
Weeks 1-3 realized outcomes are too early under the frozen prospective protocols to select or deploy a QB model change.
No new QB weight, age curve, production transform, rushing premium, or elite-tier multiplier is fit here.
